verses.1: And these are the names of the posts, from the southern side to the hand of the path leading to Enan’s palace. The border runs from the southern side to the hand of Hamat. They had a platform on top of them. The sea is one and the same.
verses.2: And on the border of Dan, from the east to the west, there is one such place.
verses.3: And on the border that extends from the east to the west, I will divide it into one section.
verses.4: And on the border of Naphthali, from the front edge all the way to the back edge, there was one man.
verses.5: And on the border of Manasseh, from the east to the west, there was one Ephraim.
verses.6: And on the border of Efrayim, from the east to the west, there was one single river.
verses.7: And on the border of Reuben, from the east to the west, there was one Judah.
verses.8: And on the border of Judah, from Kadesh to Yamta, there will be a sacred area. This area will be five hundred thousand cubits long and wide. It will be one of the sacred areas from Kadesh to Yamta. And that area will become a holy place.
verses.9: The amount that you have raised for Jehovah is five hundred thousand, and its width is twelve thousand.
verses.10: And for these purposes, there shall be a time of sacred service for the priests, which will last five hundred and twenty thousand days. There will also be a time of preparation, which will last twenty thousand days. The height of this time will be five hundred and twenty thousand days. It will be a time dedicated to Jehovah.
verses.11: To the holy priests, who were born of the tribe of Sadoq, those who kept my commandments, so that they would not stray from the ways of the Israelites, just as the Philistines did.
verses.12: And they would have a portion from the land’s produce, as it was considered sacred and worthy of being held in reverence, up to the borders of the Levites.
verses.13: And the measurements for the boundary of the priests’ territory are: five hundred and twenty thousand long, and twenty thousand wide. In total, it’s five hundred and twenty thousand long, and twenty thousand wide.
verses.14: And they shall not be sold from it, nor shall they be taken away. The beginning of the earth is holy to Jehovah.
verses.15: And five thousand men were slain on the walls of the city. This city became a place for dwelling and living in.
verses.16: And these are the measurements of her breasts: five cubits and four thousand. Her thighs also measure five cubits and four thousand. Her hips measure five cubits and four thousand. And her buttocks measure five cubits and four thousand.
verses.17: And it shall be a wall around the city, fifty cubits high. It shall also have a height of fifty cubits, and its width shall be fifty cubits.
verses.18: And the offering was taken to be used for the sacrifice of the Holy One. It took twelve thousand years and twelve thousand days before it became usable as an offering for the Holy One. And it became a food source for the people of that city.
verses.19: And the servant of the city will serve him from all the authorities of Israel.
verses.20: All the offerings were five hundred and twenty thousand; in other words, four-fifths of the offerings were used to pay for the sacred duties related to the city.
verses.21: And the tribute that must be paid to the priest from this and from that place, for the purpose of paying the sacred tax. This tax must be paid at the rate of five hundred thousand per year. This tax must also be paid along the borders of Kadima and Yamah. In total, it amounts to five hundred thousand per year. This tax is used to provide for the needs of the priests. And this is how the sacred tax is paid, along with the taxes that are paid on the sacred houses within their walls.
verses.22: And the possession of the land and the city shall be between the boundaries of Judah and the boundaries of Benyamin.
verses.23: And the rest of the branches, from the top down to the bottom, were all connected together in one whole.
verses.24: And on the border of Benyamin, from the east to the west, there is one single name.
verses.25: And on the border of Shemion, from the east to the west, one shall be appointed as a ruler.
verses.26: And on the border of Issachar, from the east to the west, there is one single territory.
verses.27: And on the border of Zebulun, from the easternmost part all the way to the westernmost part, there was one man.
verses.28: And on the border of Gad, towards the land of Negev, there would be a border marked by the boundary of the holy land, along the sea.
verses.29: This is the land where you shall worship from the altars of Israel. And these are its divisions, says the Lord God.
verses.30: And these are the exits of the city, from the east side: five thousand and four hundred miles.
verses.31: And the gates of the city were named after the rulers of Israel: three gates in total. One gate was called Roven; another gate was called Yehuda; and there was also a gate called Levi.
verses.32: And to the east, there are five thousand four hundred doors. There’s also three doors in total. Then there’s one door called Yosef, one door called Benyamin, and one door called Dan.
verses.33: And the length of it is five thousand and four hundred meters. It has three gates: one gate named Shemen, one gate named Issachar, and one gate named Zebulun.
verses.34: The length of each wall is five hundred and forty-four thousand cubits. There are three gates in each wall. In each gate, there’s one more gate. And in each of those gates, there’s one more gate.
verses.35: Around Shemona, there are ten thousand people. The name of the city is from the day when Jehovah established it.
